messages:
maria: Deploybot just put eu-canary on HOLD after a spike of 503s from the ingress. Blocking release 2025.03.18-v2 for now. @jon @elaine can you confirm root cause? :frowning:

deploy-bot: [automated] Deployment hold set by policy. Reason: external 503s from ingress-controller. Slot: 2025-03-18T02:00Z. Actions: pin current rollout, notify #eng-sre, suggest reschedule.

jon: seeing ingress-controller pods in a restart loop in EU, memory growth after the sidecar env change. Rolling back ingress image to previous sha fixed 2/3 of pods immediately. Only canary affected so far.

ops-oncall: confirmed. Traffic was routed away from canary instances; no impact to Dedicated or hosted API tiers. CDN OK. Root cause looks like new sidecar + config caused a mem leak on 1.20 image.

elaine: proposal: 1) keep the canary HOLD, 2) pin the ingress-controller component to previous image (sha:abc123), 3) reschedule the canary to the next low-traffic window (03/19 02:00 UTC), 4) tighten health-check thresholds for canary run (fail on any 5xx > 0.1%).

maria: makes sense. I want the pin + reschedule done here so we don't accidentally roll forward. Holding the full rollout until canary validates.

jon: I can do the pin now. Commands I will run:
```
# pin ingress-controller back to known-good
kubectl -n prod-eu set image deployment/ingress ingress=image@sha:abc123
/releasebot pin 2025.03.18-v2 --component ingress-controller --sha abc123
```
I'll also add a short release note line: "Reverted ingress-controller to abc123 due to memory regression observed with recent sidecar change."

releasebot: action recorded: pin applied by jon at 1757772475. Canary hold remains. Next available slot candidates: 1757850000 (2025-03-19 02:00 UTC), 1757936400 (2025-03-20 02:00 UTC).

maria: vote for 03/19 (1757850000) — quicker validation needed. @sara-product FYI for release calendar.

ops-oncall: will update release calendar and run canary smoke script during the slot. Smoke script: `scripts/smoke_canary.sh --region eu --alerts-on-failure`.

elaine: please add the extra canary checks to the smoke: ensure 200s only, 5xx ratio <0.1%, response time < 500ms for p95. Add an alert if any threshold breached.

maria: thanks. I'll draft the release note for the rollback and prepare an exec summary after the canary run. :thumbsup:

jon: pinned and monitored. I'll post a brief follow-up after we run the smoke on 03/19.

maria: perfect — locking this thread. If we see any regressions during the canary, we'll roll back the whole release and notify customers.
